sloka: प्रविष्टोऽस्मि हि ते वक्त्रं दाक्षायणि नमोऽस्तु ते ।गमिष्ये यत्र वैदेही सत्यं चासीद्वरस्तव ॥५-१-१६९॥
transliteration: praviṣṭo'smi hi te vaktraṁ dākṣāyaṇi namo'stu te ।gamiṣye yatra vaidehī satyaṁ cāsīdvarastava ॥5-1-169॥

translations.english: "O Dakshayani I have indeed entered your mouth and your boon has come true (as nobody can go against the boon of the Creator). Allow me to proceed in quest of Vaidhehi. My salutations to you."
